lines: Aaj jaane ki zid na karo
couplets.en: Please don't insist on leaving tonight.

lines: Yoon hi pehlu mein baithe raho
couplets.en: Stay here beside me a little longer.

lines: Aaj jaane ki zid na karo
couplets.en: Please don't insist on leaving tonight.

lines: Haaye mar jaayenge, hum to lut jaayenge
couplets.en: I'll be undone, left with nothing.

lines: Aaj jaane ki zid na karo
couplets.en: Please don't insist on leaving tonight.

lines: Tum hi socho zara, kyun na rokein tumhein
couplets.en: Tell me, how could I let you go?

lines: Jaan jaati hai jab uth ke jaate ho tum
couplets.en: When you rise to leave, my life goes with you.
For your own sake, my love, I beg you.

lines: Aaj jaane ki zid na karo
couplets.en: Please don't insist on leaving tonight.

lines: Waqt ki qaid mein zindagi hai magar
couplets.en: Life is held captive by time.

lines: Chand ghadiyaan yahi hain jo aazaad hain
couplets.en: Only these few moments are free.
These moments, my love, may slip away.
Don't spend a lifetime longing for them.

lines: Aaj jaane ki zid na karo
couplets.en: Please don't insist on leaving tonight.
